raw_data_location: Each users_NNN folder contains training, episode, slot, user and selection raw CSV files; root files are compact plot tables.
interpretation: This sweep jointly scales population, aggregate offered load, state dimension and action dimension; it is not an isolated action-space-only intervention.
cross_count_nesting: For a common seed and episode, existing users retain identical alpha, beta, k, U_ref, geometry, initial packet counts, per-link shadowing, arrivals and shadow innovations; additional users are appended.
